classification_rules.expected_no_op: identical stages inside one frame whose spanned occluder sources were all absent
classification_rules.no_op_placed_but_not_occluding: an occluder was placed but its recorded occlusion fraction is 0
classification_rules.unverified_no_op: same, but at least one source flag was missing from the record
classification_rules.unexpected_identical_stage: the record claims a non-zero occlusion fraction yet the stage mask is byte-identical
classification_rules.empty_target_defect: all-black target-stage mask shared by different frames
classification_rules.all_black_stage_duplicate: all-black non-target stage shared by different frames (fully occluded)
classification_rules.stale_or_mismatched_mask: identical mask bytes but different camera/K/pose across frames
classification_rules.duplicate_with_identical_geometry: identical mask bytes AND identical camera/K/pose
classification_rules.duplicate_geometry_unverifiable: identical mask bytes but geometry could not be compared
